Cable Standing Fly

The cable standing fly trains the chest with constant tension through the whole movement. Stand between two cable towers, set the pulleys at shoulder height and take one handle in each hand.

How to do it

  1. Step forward until the cables pull your arms slightly back.
  2. Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a wide arc, keeping a soft bend in the elbows.
  3. Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

Keep the movement controlled. Use a weight that allows twelve clean repetitions, and read the chest training guide for more variations.

Breathing out while the handles meet and breathing in on the way back keeps the rhythm steady and the core braced during every set.
